follow-up time: From birth until hospital discharge, death, or study end (2007-2013)
cohort: Very preterm infants born between 24 and 29 weeks' gestation and weighing <1500 g, admitted to participating neonatal units in the International Network for Evaluating Outcomes of Neonates between 2007 and 2013
finding: Survival rates of very preterm infants varied significantly between neonatal networks, with the lowest survival in Spain and the highest in Japan, and these differences persisted across gestational ages.
country: International (10 national and regional neonatal networks)
